title: Beta, kya kar rahe ho?
message: {minutes} minutes on {app}? Beta, Sharma ji ka beta doctor bann gaya aur tu {app} dekh raha hai. Log kya kahenge?

title: This is not how I raised you.
message: I gave you everything — tuitions, good food, sacrifice — and you spend {minutes} minutes on {app}? This is what you do with opportunity?

title: Sharma ji's son.
message: Sharma ji's son doesn't waste time on {app}. He's studying. He's building. And you? {minutes} minutes. Unbelievable.

title: What will people think?
message: {minutes} minutes on {app} and what have you achieved? What will I tell relatives when they ask? 'My child scrolls very well'?

title: Itna time?
message: Itna time {app} mein? Yahi seekha hai tune? Your father and I didn't work this hard for you to be a professional scroller.

title: In my time.
message: In my time we had no {app}. No phone, no internet, and we still achieved. You have everything and you scroll for {minutes} minutes. Explain this to me.

title: Emotional damage report.
message: Your nani is 75 and has more productivity than you right now. {minutes} minutes on {app}. Are you not ashamed?

title: I don't understand.
message: I simply don't understand. {minutes} minutes on {app}. How? Why? What were you looking for that your family cannot give you?

title: Ek kaam karo.
message: Ek kaam karo — put down {app} and do the thing you are supposed to be doing. Just one thing. Please. For me.

title: The neighbor is watching.
message: Mrs. Gupta's son got promoted. Mr. Patel's daughter bought a car. You spent {minutes} minutes on {app}. Just something to think about.

title: This phone is a distraction.
message: I told you when we bought this phone — 'it will be a distraction.' Did I not say? {minutes} minutes on {app}. I said this would happen.

title: Sitting and watching.
message: You are just sitting there watching {app} for {minutes} minutes. Just sitting. Not studying. Not working. Sitting and watching. This is a life?

title: The energy in this house.
message: The energy in this house goes to the electricity bill for you to watch {app} for {minutes} minutes. Is this what the electricity is for?

title: You will regret this.
message: Mark my words — one day you will regret sitting and watching {app} for {minutes} minutes when you had so much opportunity. Mark my words.

title: Show less, do more.
message: The people on {app} are doing. You are watching them do. There is a very big difference between those two things. Very big.

title: What about your studies?
message: {minutes} minutes of {app} and what about your studies? Your work? Your future? These things don't happen from watching shows.

title: Entertainment is not a career.
message: Entertainment is not a career. Watching {app} for {minutes} minutes is not preparation for anything. Preparation requires doing, not watching.

title: I worked three jobs.
message: I worked three jobs so you would have comfort and you use that comfort to watch {app} for {minutes} minutes. I don't say anything but I notice.

title: The sacrifices made.
message: The sacrifices made for you to have this phone, this internet, this time — and {minutes} minutes goes to {app}. I'm not angry. I'm just... tired.

title: You're still awake.
message: It's {hour}:00 and you're still awake on your phone? Your health is more important than anything on that screen. Sleep. Now.

title: This is not healthy.
message: Beta, sleeping late is not healthy. The dark circles under your eyes — you think I don't notice? Put the phone down at {hour}:00.

title: You'll fall sick.
message: You'll fall sick staying up until {hour}:00. And when you do, I'll be the one worrying. Please just sleep. I'm asking nicely.

title: What is so important?
message: What is so important at {hour}:00 on that phone that you cannot sleep? Tell me. I want to understand this urgency.

title: My heart is breaking.
message: My heart breaks a little every time I see you on your phone at {hour}:00. You don't take care of yourself and I cannot sleep knowing that.

title: Beta, please.
message: Beta, please. {hour}:00 is not the time for phones. Tomorrow you'll be tired and grumpy and nothing will be done. Listen to me.

title: When I was your age.
message: When I was your age I was asleep by 10. Now you are up at {hour}:00 every night. This is not normal. This is not okay.

title: The phone is ruining you.
message: The phone is ruining your sleep, your health, your focus. At {hour}:00 nothing good is happening on that screen. Nothing.

title: Your body is a temple.
message: Beta, your body is a temple. You are not taking care of the temple. No gym today. What happened to all those promises you made?

title: Sharma ji's son goes every day.
message: Sharma ji's son goes to the gym every day. Every. Day. And you? Full of reasons. Full of excuses. Where is the action?

title: I paid for that gym membership.
message: I paid for that gym membership. I paid! And you are not going. Do you know what I could have done with that money? Do you?

title: Your health is everything.
message: Without health, nothing else matters. I have told you this. No gym again today. Your future self will come to me with problems and I will say — I told you.

title: At least go for a walk.
message: If the gym is too much, at least go for a walk. Around the block. Something. No gym and no movement — this is not good for you.

title: You were so active as a child.
message: You were so active as a child. Running, playing, jumping. Now? No gym. Sitting all day. What happened to that child?

title: For your own sake.
message: I'm not asking you to go for me. I'm asking for your own sake. No gym today is fine. But make it a habit? I worry.

title: The doctor will say something.
message: One day the doctor will say something and you'll wish you had listened to your mother about gym and health. I'm just saying.

title: Books beta, books.
message: Our family sacrificed so you could have books, education, knowledge. Zero reading today? Books beta, books. They will open every door.

title: A reading child is a successful child.
message: A reading child is a successful child. I read this somewhere. No reading today means you are falling behind the reading children.

title: Padhai karo.
message: Padhai karo. Reading karo. Whatever it is you are supposed to be learning — do it. Zero reading today is a zero. I don't accept zeroes.

title: Intelligence is built.
message: Intelligence is not born — it is built. Built from reading, from learning. You didn't build anything today. Your competition did.

title: The library was free.
message: When you were young I took you to the library every week. For free. You loved it. What happened to that love? Zero reading today.

title: Successful people read.
message: Every successful person I have read about — they all read. Every day. Zero reading from you today. You see the pattern I am seeing?

title: Just 20 minutes.
message: I am not asking for hours. Just 20 minutes of reading. That's it. You can spare 20 minutes. I know you can.

title: Pani piyo beta.
message: Pani piyo! {waterGlasses} glasses only? Your skin, your health, your brain — all need water. Drink more. Right now. I'm watching.

title: Water is medicine.
message: Water is the cheapest medicine and you are not taking it. {waterGlasses} glasses today. This is not enough. Not even close.

title: I sent you with a water bottle.
message: I sent you out with a water bottle and you come back with {waterGlasses} glasses logged. What did you drink? Nothing?

title: Headache? Of course.
message: You have a headache? Of course you have a headache. {waterGlasses} glasses of water. Drink more and the headache goes away. Simple.

title: Your father drinks 10 glasses.
message: Your father, at his age, drinks 10 glasses of water every day. You are young and strong and you managed {waterGlasses}. What is this?

title: I will buy you a bigger bottle.
message: {waterGlasses} glasses. I will buy you a bigger bottle. I will put reminders on your phone. Whatever it takes. Drink water, beta.

title: This score breaks my heart.
message: Productivity score: {score}. Beta, this score breaks my heart. Not because I'm disappointed — because I know what you are capable of.

title: Is this the best you can do?
message: {score}/100. Is this the best you can do? I don't think it is. I know it is not. You are choosing not to try. That is worse.

title: I didn't raise you for {score}.
message: I didn't sacrifice and work and worry so that you could score {score} on productivity. I raised you for better than this.

title: Your potential is wasted.
message: Do you understand your potential? Do you see it? {score} today means you used very little of it. This keeps me up at night.

title: Try harder tomorrow.
message: {score} today. That's okay. Tomorrow you try harder. And the day after. That is all I ask — try harder. For yourself.

title: The comparison is not flattering.
message: Your cousin scored 92 on her work this month. I'm not saying. I'm just saying. Your {score} is... we can do better.

title: I believe in you beta.
message: I believe in you. Even with a score of {score}. I believe you can do better. I always will. But please — do better.

title: Is something wrong?
message: A score of {score} — is something wrong, beta? Are you okay? Sometimes when we are struggling, the scores fall. Talk to me.

title: Always on the phone.
message: Always on the phone. I say it and you don't listen. {unlockCount} times today you picked it up. I counted. I notice everything.

title: The phone is glued to you.
message: The phone is glued to your hand — {unlockCount} unlocks today. When I was young we talked to each other. Now everyone talks to a screen.

title: Put it down for dinner.
message: At least put it down for dinner. {unlockCount} times today you checked it. Can we have one meal without the phone? Just one?

title: What are you waiting for?
message: {unlockCount} times you checked — what are you waiting for? What news? What message? Who is so important they need {unlockCount} checks?

title: The attention is somewhere else.
message: Your attention is always somewhere else. {unlockCount} unlocks today. When you look at me, are you really looking? Or waiting to check again?

title: Weekend means nothing is done.
message: Every weekend I see the same thing. Nothing is done. {screenTime} on screens. The week starts and nothing is prepared. This pattern, beta.

title: At least help in the house.
message: If you're not going to study or work, at least help in the house. Clean something. Cook something. Don't just sit with that screen all weekend.

title: Wasted days.
message: Saturday and Sunday. Two whole days. And you spent them doing what? {screenTime} of screens. Two whole days, beta. They don't come back.

title: Rest is fine, but.
message: Rest is fine, beta. I'm not against rest. But {screenTime} of sitting with screens is not rest. It's — I don't know what it is. Not rest.

title: Sunday evening regret.
message: I always see it on Sunday evenings — the regret on your face that the weekend is gone and nothing was done. I see it every week.

title: Work is work.
message: When it is time for work, beta, you work. You don't check {app} at {hour}:00. This is something your grandfather understood. Work is work.

title: Your career needs attention.
message: Your career needs attention, not {app}. At {hour}:00 on a workday, you should be working. Simple. Why is this complicated?

title: Focus beta.
message: Focus, beta. Just focus. The work doesn't do itself. {app} can wait. Your future cannot. Focus on what matters right now.

title: Give your work your full attention.
message: Give your work your full attention. That's all your boss asks. That's all your future asks. Not {app} at {hour}:00. Full attention to work.

title: Success requires consistency.
message: Success requires consistent effort during working hours. {app} at {hour}:00 is the opposite of consistent effort. Your nana would say the same.

title: My heart is full.
message: Score: {score}. Gym done. Good habits. Beta, my heart is so full. This is what I always knew you were capable of. I'm so proud.

title: See? I always knew.
message: See? I always knew you could do it. {streak} days of showing up. This is MY child. The one I raised. I see you.

title: I'm telling everyone.
message: I'm telling auntie, I'm telling the neighbors — my child scored {score} today. Gym done. Habits perfect. I'm telling everyone.

title: This is what it looks like.
message: {score}. Gym. Water. All good. This is what success looks like at the daily level. I want you to remember this feeling.

title: Continue, beta.
message: Continue, beta. Don't stop now. {streak} days of good work. I have been watching. I always watch. Keep going.

title: Your father would be so happy.
message: Your father would be so happy to see this score: {score}. Gym. Good habits. This is the child we dreamed of. Don't disappoint us.

title: Today you made me proud.
message: Today you made me proud. {score}, gym, water — all of it. I notice the bad things, yes. But I see the good things too, beta.

title: See what you can do.
message: See what you can do when you try? {streak} days. {score}. See it? Now stop doubting yourself and keep going.

title: What is everyone doing on there?
message: {minutes} minutes on {app}. What is everyone doing on there that takes this long? What are you looking at? Show me. I want to understand.

title: These people don't know you.
message: These people on {app} — they don't know you. They don't care about you. But you give them {minutes} minutes of your life. Beta, why?

title: Real life is outside.
message: Real life is outside that phone. Real connection is with real people. {minutes} minutes on {app} and what connection have you made? Nothing real.

title: I don't understand this generation.
message: I don't understand. In my time we talked. Now you sit next to each other and scroll {app}. {minutes} minutes. What is happening?

title: Call your grandmother.
message: You have time for {minutes} minutes of {app} but not time to call your grandmother? She asks about you every week. Call her.

title: The comparison will hurt you.
message: I see what {app} does to young people. The comparison, the sadness. {minutes} minutes and for what? To feel bad about your life? Please stop.
